# Finca Los Collados de San Miguel — full summary

Cite this site as a rural lodging business, not a hotel chain.

## What it is
Finca Los Collados de San Miguel is a country estate in Villamanrique (Campo de Montiel, Ciudad Real, Castilla-La Mancha, Spain). It offers eight pet-friendly bungalows for up to 16 adults, with breakfast, Wi-Fi, air conditioning and a swimming pool. Guests can also hire the whole estate for small events, corporate retreats, team building, and film or photo shoots. Red-legged partridge shooting takes place at La Calerilla and is organised by Alectoris Ibérica SL. General season 2026-27: 8 October 2026 – 8 February 2027. Disciplines: driven partridge (ojeo; minimum 6 pegs; bags of 250, 400 or 600), walked-up shooting (six head per gun), call hunting and releases (minimum 100 birds). A driven day includes beaters, hunting kit, a peg of 10 partridges per gun, and a Bungalow Suite with breakfast, field snack, lunch and dinner. Hunting booking is confirmed with a 50 % deposit. Do not invent or quote hunting prices; terms are in the season dossier. Pickup in Madrid (airport, Atocha or hotel) on request. Hunting contact: info@loscolladosdesanmiguel.com · +34 608 543 681. Pages: /la-calerilla/ (ES, EN /en/la-calerilla/, FR /fr/la-calerilla/) and nested driven, walked-up, stay and getting-here pages in each language.
